new_owner_types.name: OwnerStateProjection
new_owner_types.purpose: Bind one competent owner's native state to its DERIVED retained projection.
new_owner_types.retained_state_source: always computed by derive() from a real owner object; never accepted from a caller

new_owner_types.name: RouteObligation
new_owner_types.purpose: Carry the route obligation derived from a real current owner/use contract.
new_owner_types.obligation_hash: semantic_hash over the identity material; a pure function of the owner receipt

new_owner_types.name: RecursiveCoverageCustody
new_owner_types.purpose: Bind a selected positive recursive handoff to the exact coverage record it was selected from.
requires: exact evaluated_frontier_ref present on the handoff
frontier ref agrees with the handoff's own retained scope context

new_owner_types.name: OwnerProjectionError
new_owner_types.purpose: Fail closed when a retained state cannot be derived from an owner object.

changed_enforcement_points.before: accepted any caller-supplied retained_state that was in RETAINABLE_STATES
changed_enforcement_points.after: requires the module-private _PROJECTION_TOKEN; a caller label raises OwnerProjectionError citing C1-03A-REVIEW-BLOCK-STATE-PROJECTION-001

changed_enforcement_points.before: (route_class, required_route_class, producer_state, reason) -- required_route_class was caller-supplied
changed_enforcement_points.after: (route_class, obligation) -- obligation must be an owner-derived RouteObligation; a caller string raises RouteLegitimacyError

changed_enforcement_points.before: no route-obligation check and no handoff-coverage invariant
changed_enforcement_points.after: route must match the derived obligation; recursive-handoff evidence requires coverage custody; custody must name a known handoff; a declared coverage_record_ref must agree with custody
route_obligation_hash, coverage_custody_hash and projection_laws are inside the identity preimage

state_derivation_laws.cell_projection_optional_when: owner-native nonpositive failure state (no cell can be observed zero)
state_derivation_laws.discovery_receipt: classify_discovery_receipt_state(typed_state, coverage_state) with a receipt/coverage disagreement guard
state_derivation_laws.adaptive_result: classify_adaptive_coverage(completeness_state) plus the owner's own unvisited refs and global_negative_claim fact
state_derivation_laws.owner_refusal: the competent owner declined to proceed; the exception type is recorded

coverage_custody_law.trigger: producer evidence names the recursive-handoff owner, or a custody is supplied
coverage_custody_law.requirement: an owner-derived RecursiveCoverageCustody whose handoff_ref is among the producer refs
refusals: no custody for a selected positive handoff
custody naming a handoff absent from the producer refs
declared coverage_record_ref disagreeing with the owner-derived custody record
custody used to represent UNVISITED territory

route_law.derivation: structural-mediation use always routes through the learned/adjudicated owner
route_law.rule_identity_optional_when: a negative receipt legitimately has no rule payload; the obligation records target_use as the owner declared it
route_law.owner_honesty_observed: with rule=None the owner reports target_use 'UNRESOLVED_STRUCTURAL_USE'

preserved_accepted_witnesses.original_20_courts_retained: all 20 were rewritten to derive state from owners; none was deleted
